name: Shouji Kimiko
source:
A nurse at Umegaoka Memorial General Hospital, [url=/c4989]Fujimaru Rie[/url]'s colleague. Unlike her Kimiko is not as passionate for her work as she only tries to make a living from it.
At first glance, she looks like one who often goes places, but in reality she spends most of her holidays watching TV at home.

Favorite food: Ethnic food, spicy food in general.
Things she wants to do: Scuba diving, round-the-world trip.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
